abnormal behavior: The teacher noticed some abnormal behavior in the quiet boy, so she called his parents to talk about it.
老師注意到那個安靜男孩有些異常行為，所以打電話給他的父母討論這件事。
abnormally high temperatures: The city suffered abnormally high temperatures this April, and many people had to turn on their air conditioners early.
這座城市今年四月遭遇異常高溫，許多人不得不提早開冷氣。
an abnormal heartbeat: During the health check, the doctor found an abnormal heartbeat and asked my father to see a heart specialist.
健康檢查時，醫生發現心律不整，並要我父親去看心臟專科醫師。
an abrupt change of plan: Because of the coming typhoon, there was an abrupt change of plan, and our class trip was canceled the night before.
由於颱風即將來襲，計畫突然改變，我們的班遊在前一晚被取消了。
come to an abrupt end: The concert came to an abrupt end when the power suddenly went out in the middle of the last song.
最後一首歌唱到一半突然停電，演唱會因此戛然而止。
an abrupt manner: The clerk answered our questions in an abrupt manner, which made us feel unwelcome in the shop.
店員以唐突無禮的態度回答我們的問題，讓我們覺得在店裡不受歡迎。
an abrupt turn: The bus made an abrupt turn to avoid a dog in the road, and several passengers almost fell down.
公車為了閃避路上的狗來了個急轉彎，好幾位乘客差點跌倒。
absolute power: The old king held absolute power, so no one in the country dared to question any of his decisions.
老國王握有絕對權力，所以國內沒有人敢質疑他的任何決定。
an absolute beginner: I am an absolute beginner at the guitar, so I still cannot play even one simple song.
我是吉他的完全初學者，所以連一首簡單的歌都還彈不出來。
absolute silence: When the teacher walked in with the test papers, there was absolute silence in the classroom.
老師拿著考卷走進來時，教室裡一片寂靜。
the absolute minimum: To save money for college, she keeps her spending to the absolute minimum and rarely eats out.
為了存大學學費，她把開銷壓到最低限度，很少外食。
absolute nonsense: My brother said that eating carrots lets you see in the dark, but that is absolute nonsense.
我哥哥說吃紅蘿蔔能讓人在黑暗中看見東西，但那根本是一派胡言。
an abstract concept: For young children, time is an abstract concept, so they often ask how long one hour really is.
對幼童來說，時間是個抽象概念，所以他們常問一小時到底有多長。
abstract art: Some visitors to the museum did not understand the abstract art, which was full of colorful lines and shapes.
有些博物館參觀者看不懂那些抽象藝術，畫面滿是彩色的線條和形狀。
in the abstract: It is easy to talk about helping the poor in the abstract, but actually doing something is much harder.
就抽象理論而言談論幫助窮人很容易，但真正採取行動卻難得多。
abstract nouns: Words like "love" and "freedom" are abstract nouns because you cannot see or touch the things they name.
像「愛」和「自由」這類字是抽象名詞，因為它們所指的東西看不見也摸不著。
an absurd idea: Wearing a winter coat to the beach in July seemed like an absurd idea to everyone in my family.
七月穿冬季大衣去海邊，對我們全家人來說都是個荒謬的想法。
It is absurd to suggest that…: It is absurd to suggest that students can learn a new language well in just one week.
說學生只要一週就能學好一種新語言，這種說法荒謬至極。
the theater of the absurd: In drama class, we read a play from the theater of the absurd about two men waiting for nobody.
在戲劇課上，我們讀了一部荒謬劇場的劇本，內容是兩個男人在等一個不存在的人。
be abundant in natural resources: The country is abundant in natural resources such as oil and gold, but many of its people are still poor.
那個國家自然資源豐富，例如石油和黃金，但許多國民仍然貧窮。
abundant evidence: Scientists have found abundant evidence that smoking causes serious damage to the lungs.
科學家已找到大量證據，證明吸菸會對肺部造成嚴重傷害。
an abundant supply of water: The village is close to a large lake, so it has an abundant supply of water even in summer.
那個村莊靠近一座大湖，所以即使在夏天也有充足的水源。
academic performance: Getting enough sleep can improve your academic performance, because a rested brain learns and remembers better.
充足的睡眠能提升你的學業表現，因為休息充分的大腦學得更好、記得更牢。
an academic year: In Taiwan, an academic year usually begins in September and ends in late June.
在台灣，一個學年通常從九月開始，到六月下旬結束。
academic freedom: The professors believe that academic freedom allows them to research and teach any topic without government control.
教授們認為學術自由讓他們能不受政府控制地研究和教授任何主題。
a purely academic question: Whether we would win the game was a purely academic question, since it had already been canceled because of rain.
我們會不會贏得比賽只是純理論、不切實際的問題，因為比賽早已因雨取消。
be acceptable to all parties: After weeks of talks, the two companies finally reached a deal that was acceptable to all parties involved.
經過數週的協商，兩家公司終於達成了一項各方都能接受的協議。
socially acceptable behavior: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT is not considered socially acceptable behavior in Taipei.
在台北，搭捷運時大聲講電話不被視為社會上可接受的行為。
an acceptable level of risk: The doctor explained that the surgery carried an acceptable level of risk, so my grandfather agreed to have it.
醫生解釋這項手術的風險在可接受的程度內，所以我祖父同意接受手術。
